arguments.query: small business needs help with data organization or reporting

results.text: An independent audio publisher mentions that useful interviews are difficult for its audience to search and reference later.
A small workshop asks peers how they track changing supplier prices and lead times for recurring materials.
A newsletter publisher wonders which recurring questions in its archive would justify a focused guide.
A repair business has conflicting public descriptions of what its standard service includes, and customers keep asking the same questions.
A small professional practice is publicly comparing several software subscriptions but lacks a consistent cost and feature analysis.

arguments.scope: Create a single clear, consistent public-facing description of the repair business's standard service (what's included, what's not, typical scope boundaries, and answers to the most common customer questions) to replace conflicting descriptions across channels. Delivered as a ready-to-publish document.
